mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversations (user_id, conversation_id, patient_id, status, version, deleted_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{patientId}, 'active', 0, NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE patient_id = IF(deleted_time IS NOT NULL, VALUES(patient_id), patient_id), status = IF(deleted_time IS NOT NULL, 'active', status), version = IF(deleted_time IS NOT NULL, version + 1, version), deleted_time = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, conversation_id, patient_id, status, version, create_time, update_time, deleted_time FROM ai_conversations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'active' AND deleted_time IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversations SET status = 'deleted', deleted_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND deleted_time IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT c.conversation_id, COALESCE(( SELECT LEFT(m.content, 60) FROM chat_messages m WHERE m.user_id = c.user_id AND m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id AND m.role = 'user' ORDER BY m.create_time ASC, m.id ASC LIMIT 1 ), '新的问诊') AS title, ( SELECT LEFT(m.content, 120) FROM chat_messages m WHERE m.user_id = c.user_id AND m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_messages m WHERE m.user_id = c.user_id AND m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id ) AS message_count, COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(m.create_time) FROM chat_messages m WHERE m.user_id = c.user_id AND m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id ), c.update_time) AS update_time FROM ai_conversations c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'active' AND c.deleted_time IS NULL ORDER BY update_time DESC, c.conversation_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
